classification_definitions.confirmed_parser_or_normalization_issue: Reserved for a source-to-normalized mismatch confirmed during review; none found in this snapshot.
classification_definitions.confirmed_source_duplicate: Source contains repeated declaration content under the same UUID, with identical or whitespace-only semantic content.
classification_definitions.expected_identity_collision: Repeated case-folded name across distinct declaration UUIDs; names are not treated as stable identity keys.
classification_definitions.plausible_statistical_outlier: Source value matches the archived XML and is an extreme value under the global median/MAD detector; it is retained as a review flag, not corrected.
classification_definitions.source_valid_negative_balance: Negative bank-account value is preserved verbatim by the source and is consistent with an overdraft.
classification_definitions.unresolved_source_anomaly: Evidence is insufficient or conflicting; the source and normalized rows remain retained.
